title: application of studies
description: i was responsible for developing the 'my exercise lists' screen in a platform designed for students and exam candidates. the layout was already defined, so my focus was on implementing display logic, optimizing performance to avoid bottlenecks or slow loading, and ensuring responsiveness. i used vue.js with typescript, applying conditional rendering, optimized array searches, and asynchronous integrations with a nestjs backend also written in typescript.

title: application of studies
description: i was responsible for implementing the filter section of the 'create lists' screen in a platform for students and exam candidates. in addition to display logic, i focused on performance and responsiveness, using pinia for global state management. the solution was built with vue.js and performs frequent requests to the backend, ensuring efficient data synchronization and a smooth user experience.

title: application for colleges and teachers
description: i was responsible for building an alert modal on the 'create online list' screen, designed for teachers, managers, and directors. the modal performs failure checks through backend requests and responds dynamically based on the results. development was done with javascript and react, integrated with a nestjs backend, ensuring reliability in the alert flow and immediate feedback to users.

title: custom checkout
description: i was responsible for developing screens for a custom checkout builder, allowing vendors to configure the fields they want to display to their customers, with pages generated dynamically. the solution was developed with react and typescript, focusing on scalability, componentization, and flexibility to support multiple use cases.

title: mini-vue-framework
description: an experimental project in which i developed a reactive page using only html and vanilla javascript. built with modern javascript, it leverages proxy for reactivity, dynamic dom updates, and event binding. the goal is to demonstrate core concepts such as state management, component-like structures, and the foundations of reactivity in javascript.
